description: Check anything LLPRO signed (a Receipt v1, a Countersign stamp, an Agent Record entry or receipt, a Trust-product answer) against the signer's public key AND LLPRO's published key list (https://llpro.ai/.well-known/llpro-keys.json): a key that is not listed for the product the record names fails. Returns PASS/FAIL and what the pass shows. Nothing is stored.

public_key.description: signer's Ed25519 public key, base64, from the product's page

receipt.description: the signed record exactly as the product gave it

name: receipt_verify
title: Check a signed LLPRO record
